# 0.4.11

## 本次更新

- 修复“登录成功但设置/每日精选/关注仍显示未登录”：重新打开登录页会取消陈旧 OAuth 事务并新建流程；首次登录不会在只确认网页 Cookie 时提前关闭，OAuth 完成后才返回。
- 首页个性化推荐的网页会话改为 DeviantArt 首页服务端验证：匿名或过期 Cookie 会明确提示登录并更新 Cookie；WAF/网络拦截走退避，不会误报成匿名。
- 显式退出登录后，即使本地 token 清理失败，下次启动也不会用遗留 token 复活登录状态；进入网页登录页会先校验 OAuth token 是否仍有效。
- 同步更新认证与网页会话文档，明确 OAuth 与网页 Cookie 的一次登录契约。

- Fixes “login succeeded but Settings / Daily / Watched still show signed out”: reopening the login screen cancels stale OAuth transactions and starts a fresh flow; first-time login no longer closes after confirming only the web Cookie.
- Personalized home recommendations now verify the web session against the DeviantArt home page: anonymous or expired cookies prompt a login and cookie refresh, while WAF/network interruptions back off instead of pretending to be anonymous.
- An explicit logout can no longer be undone by a leftover local token on the next launch; opening the login screen first revalidates the OAuth token.
- Authentication and web-session documentation now describe the single login contract for OAuth plus Cookie.
